author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect).** Migration 18: audit_log (seq BIGSERIAL, ts, actor, kind, payload JSONB, prev_hash BYTEA, this_hash BYTEA). BEFORE INSERT trigger computes this_hash = SHA-256(prev_hash || canonical_cbor(payload) || ts || actor || kind). polaris-backend/src/audit/{log,attestation}.rs. AuditLog::record(event) takes a transaction so audit row commits atomically with the event being audited. Attestation worker reuses BlobStore from #33 (in-memory for tests). xtask audit-verify walks chain from seq=1. Long-chain test: 1k events (100k deferred to #72 perf follow-up). Byte-offset tamper diagnostic deferred — row-level detection ships.
